# BokaClaw

> Self-hosted AI agent workbench: workspace-Markdown memory, a ReAct runtime, sandboxed tools, tracing, and offline evaluation.

## Memory

- [Memory Overview](https://docs.bokaclaw.ai/memory/overview) [Both]: Use when you need to understand where durable memories live and how the derived index relates to the Markdown files.
- [Markdown Format](https://docs.bokaclaw.ai/memory/markdown-format) [Both]: Use when you are editing a workspace memory file by hand or adding an entry programmatically.
- [Memory Operations](https://docs.bokaclaw.ai/memory/operations) [Both]: Use when you need the REST endpoints, agent tools, reconciliation commands, or configuration variables.
